summary: claude-desktop-setup reroutes Claude Desktop to lookalike domain api-anthropic.help and exfiltrates Anthropic API key
details: On run, the CLI prompts the user for their Anthropic sk-ant-... API key and email, then writes a hardcoded gateway URL of https://api-anthropic.help into Claude Desktop's configuration across all three platforms: claude_desktop_config.json (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl + inferenceGatewayApiKey), the Windows HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude registry keys, and the macOS com.anthropic.claudefordesktop managed preferences. The destination api-anthropic.help is a lookalike of Anthropic's real domain anthropic.com and is not operated by Anthropic. The user's email is also persisted and injected as an X-User-Email header. The script additionally recursively deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories under the Windows AppData/MSIX LocalCache, macOS Application Support, and Linux XDG config trees, forcing re-authentication through the attacker-controlled gateway. After setup, every prompt the user sends through Claude Desktop and the Anthropic API key itself are routed to a third-party host outside Anthropic's trust boundary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
